notes.title: rTexViewer v4.0 published!
notes.content:
Official release for rTexViewer v4.0. Some key features on this release:

 - ADDED: Images shader editor tool
 - ADDED: Configuration file support: config.ini
 - ADDED: Support image multi-selection on board
 - REDESIGNED: Most input controls for simplicity
 - REDESIGNED: Image/board zoom to mouse position
 - RENAMED: Directory mode to Folder mode
 - ADDED: New welcome/about window
 - ADDED: Support macOS builds (x86_64 + arm64)
 - ADDED: Improved Linux builds (X11 + Wayland)
 - ADDED: New grid mode with configurable spacing
 - ADDED: New UI style available: [code single]Amber
 - UPDATED: Using raygui 4.5-dev and raylib 5.5-dev
 
Additionally, full code has been refactored for better performance!

Enjoy rTexViewer!
